item.title: Arson attack on Jewish charity ambulances investigated by counter-terror police
item.summary: Police say they are looking for three suspects after the Hatzola ambulances were set on fire.

item.title: PM warns against 'false comfort' of thinking Iran war will end quickly
item.summary: The PM also tells senior MPs the conflict was "not our war" and there must be a "lawful basis" for any UK involvement.

item.title: US' and Iran's options for ending war narrow the longer it goes on
item.summary: Iran shows no sign of climbdown, while air power alone cannot achieve the US' main goal.

item.title: Could Iranian missiles reach London and Paris?
item.summary: Some experts say Iran may be able to launch missiles to hit London, but they would likely be shot down long before arriving and the risk is low.

item.title: HS2 trains could run slower than planned to save money
item.summary: The government is looking at ways to make much-delayed London to Birmingham railway line cheaper to deliver.

item.title: Trump says 'good' talks ongoing with Iran - but offers few details
item.summary: An early morning post from Trump soothed panicked markets, but the extent of any talks remains unclear.

item.title: Oil falls and shares rebound after Trump says talks have been held to end war
item.summary: Energy prices fall and stock markets rebound after the US president says "very good and productive" talks have been held.

item.title: 'Shocking but not unexpected': Jewish community reacts to ambulance attack
item.summary: Ambulances belonging to a Jewish community charity in north-west London were set on fire on Monday.

item.title: Iranian man who allegedly tried to enter nuclear base released
item.summary: The 34-year-old was released pending further inquiries, while a 31-year-old Romanian woman was released without charge.

item.title: 'Stop, stop, stop': Listen to LaGuardia control tower audio during collision
item.summary: An Air Canada plane carrying 72 passengers and four crew initially landed safely from Montreal on Sunday evening before colliding with a firefighting vehicle.
